dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent elliptical and semi-circular 'O' and 'C' shaped rings are distributed across the central and posterior lateral flank. These features exhibit high-contrast perimeters with a light-gray to white intensity transitioning into darker gray or charcoal interiors. The edge geometry is characterized by a relatively sharp outer boundary and a softer, diffused internal gradient.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: There is a moderate density of localized, solid, high-intensity light-gray pixel clusters interspersed among the macro-annuli. These blobs are particularly concentrated in the lower posterior section of the torso and lack the internal gradient found in the annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A prominent cluster of three large macro-annuli forms an obtuse triangular relationship in the mid-flank region. This core group is geometrically linked to a series of smaller annuli and high-intensity blobs posteriorly, creating an irregular, elongated polygonal network across the lateral surface.
